Package com.google.adk.workflow

Class EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.workflow.EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain
Enclosing class:
EdgesBuilder
@Experimental public static final class EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain extends Object
A chain of edges positioned at a node, started by EdgesBuilder.from(Node), EdgesBuilder.fromStart() or EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(com.google.adk.workflow.JoinNode). then(Node) and chain(com.google.adk.workflow.Node, com.google.adk.workflow.Node, com.google.adk.workflow.Node...) add edges and continue from the last node they connect, a fan-out continues from its targets as a group, and a routing map ends the chain.

    Method
    Description
    EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain
    chain(Node first, Node second, Node... rest)
    Connects the current node to first, second and each node in rest in order, and continues from the last one: g.fromStart().chain(a, b) is short for g.fromStart().then(a).then(b).
    void
    route(Consumer<? super EdgesBuilder.RouteMap> routeMapDefinition)
    Adds the current node's routing map, which routeMapDefinition fills, and ends the chain.
    EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain
    then(Node next)
    Connects the current node to next and continues from next.
    EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain
    then(Node first, Node second, Node... rest)
    Fans out by connecting the current node to first, second and each node in rest, like then(Collection): g.from(a).then(b, c).joinTo(join).
    EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain
    then(Collection<? extends Node> targets)
    Fans out by connecting the current node to each of targets (such as a computed list) so they run concurrently, and continues from them as a group that EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(com.google.adk.workflow.JoinNode) can join.

      @CanIgnoreReturnValue public EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain then(Node next)

    • then

      @CanIgnoreReturnValue public EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain then(Collection<? extends Node> targets)
      Fans out by connecting the current node to each of targets (such as a computed list) so they run concurrently, and continues from them as a group that EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(com.google.adk.workflow.JoinNode) can join. An empty collection adds no edges.

    • route

      public void route(Consumer<? super EdgesBuilder.RouteMap> routeMapDefinition)
      Adds the current node's routing map, which routeMapDefinition fills, and ends the chain.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the routing map has no entries
      IllegalStateException - if an entry started by EdgesBuilder.RouteMap.on(java.lang.String) has no target
